author: nickyeow

english.text: You'd better return home at once.

english.text: Although her house is nearby, I seldom see her.

jyutping: ngo5 hou2 hou2 coi2，wan2 dou3 jat1 go3 hou2 ge3 bou2 mou5。

english.text: My sister made me a beautiful doll.

jyutping: ngo5 gaa1 ze1 zing2 zo2 go3 hou2 leng3 ge3 gung1 zai2 bei2 ngo5。

text: 我唔明點解佢哋可以攞你啲嘢嚟保管，但係之後個郵局佬黐晒線噉同你講「對唔住，我哋唔見咗」，並期望緊呢個係結局。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: And the angel of the Lord called to Abraham a second time from heaven, saying: By my own self have I sworn, saith the Lord: because thou hast done this thing, and hast not spared thy only begotten son for my sake: I will bless thee, and I will multiply thy seed as the stars of heaven, and as the sand that is by the sea shore; thy seed shall possess the gates of their enemies. And in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed, because thou hast obeyed my voice.

jyutping: zyu2 ge3 tin1 si3 dai6 ji6 ci3 cung4 tin1 soeng6 fu1 ziu6 aa3 baak3 laai1 hon2，waa6：zyu2 waa6：ngo5 kaau3 zi6 gei2 hei2 sai6，jan1 wai6 nei5 zou6 zo2 ni1 gin6 si6，ji4 ce2 mou5 wai6 ngo5 ge3 jyun4 gu3 ji4 fong3 gwo3 nei5 ge3 duk6 sang1 zi2。nei5 ge3 hau6 doi6 zoeng1 wui5 jung2 jau5 keoi5 dei6 dik6 jan4 ge3 sing4 mun4。jan1 wai6 nei5 teng1 cung4 ngo5 ge3 sing1 jam1，dei6 soeng5 maan6 gwok3 dou1 wui5 jan1 nei5 ge3 hau6 doi6 ji4 dak1 fuk1。
text: 主嘅天使第二次從天上呼召亞伯拉罕，話：主話：我靠自己起誓，因為你做咗呢件事，而且冇為我嘅缘故而放過你嘅獨生子。你嘅後代將會擁有佢哋敵人嘅城門。因為你聽從我嘅聲音，地上萬國都會因你嘅後代而得福。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: In the cloudy, yet sunny, afternoon was my third walk of the day, here on Lulu Island. I was at Yummy Slice pizzeria to drink a grey-can Diet Coke. I exercised with my hand grip strengthener at my table. Sachet the Gujarati and Navjot the Punjabi were the vendors. There were throngs of parents with their Eurasian kids, eating or ordering pizza. I visited Kin's Farm Market. The radio was playing Xmas songs. Leo, the Cantonese vendor who speaks also Mandarin, exclaimed, "Viktor, bā bái!" The fragrance of baked Japanese sweet potato, "yaki-imo" in Japanese, "rostita batato" in Esperanto, was tempting. There was a metallic rectangular oven with heated stones inside. The colourful fruits enthralled me. The durian was still so dear! Today is the 9th of December of 2024.

jyutping: hai2 do1 wan4，daan6 hai6 jau6 cing4 long5 ge3 cing4 fong3 haa6，aa3 zau1 hai6 ngo5 gam1 jat6 dai6 saam1 ci3 haang4，nei1 dou6 hai6 lou6 lou6 dou2。ngo5 hai2 Yummy Slice bok6 beng2 pou2 jam2 zo2 gun3 gin6 ji4 ho2 lok6。ngo5 hai2 ngo5 zoeng1 toi2 dou6 jung6 ngo5 ge3 sau2 aak1 koeng4 faa3 hei3 zou6 wan6 dung6。gu2 gat1 laai1 dak6 jan4 saat3 cit3 dak6 tung4 pong4 ze1 pou2 jan4 naap6 fu1 joek3 dak6 hai6 siu2 faan2。jau5 seng4 baan1 fu6 mou5 daai3 zyu6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 au1 aa3 siu2 pang4 jau5，sik6 gan2 je5 waak6 ze2 giu3 gan2 bok6 beng2。ngo5 heoi3 zo2 Kin ge3 nung4 si5 coeng4。go3 sau1 jam1 gei1 bo3 gan2 sing3 daan3 go1。tung4 si4 sik1 dak1 gong2 waa4 jyu5 ge3 hoeng1 gong2 siu2 faan2 Leo daai6 giu3：「Viktor ， bā bái!」guk6 jat6 bun2 hung4 syu4 ge3 hoeng1 mei6，jat6 man2 hai6「yaki-imo」，sai3 gaai3 man4 hai6「 rostita batato 」，hou2 jau5 jan4。ng5 ngaan4 luk6 sik1 ge3 seoi2 gwo2 ling6 ngo5 mai4 soeng5 zo2，lau4 lin4 zung6 hai6 gam2 can1 oi3！
text: 喺多雲，但係又晴朗嘅情況下，亞洲係我今日第三次行，呢度係露露島。我喺 Yummy Slice 薄餅舖飲咗罐健怡可樂。我喺我張檯度用我嘅手握強化器做運動。古吉拉特人薩切特同旁遮普人納夫約特係小販。有成班父母帶住佢哋嘅歐亞小朋友，食緊嘢或者叫緊薄餅。我去咗 Kin 嘅農市場。個收音機播緊聖誕歌。同時識得講華語嘅香港小販 Leo 大叫：「Viktor ， bā bái!」焗日本紅薯嘅香味，日文係「yaki-imo」，世界文係「 rostita batato 」，好誘人。五顏六色嘅水果令我迷上咗，榴槤仲係咁親愛！
